Hi Sam & Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

What we heard (high level):
- Goal: accelerate generation quality for customer support summaries while reducing token cost ~30%.
- Primary success metrics: extractive accuracy on summary tasks (F1), end-to-end latency under 300ms p50, and cost per 1k tokens.
- Constraints: must run in VPC/private deployment for PHI scope; security/compliance questions to be addressed before trial.

Proposed next step: evaluation kickoff / trial planning call where we:
1) review the trial plan (scope, timeline, dataset/prompt set),
2) align on success criteria and pass/fail gates,
3) schedule a technical deep dive/demo for your infra and SRE folks.

I attached the latest eval plan for reference (Redwood-Eval-Plan-v2.pdf). Can you confirm which of these windows works for your team for a 60-minute kickoff?

- Tue 11/24 10:00-11:00 AM PT
- Wed 11/25 9:00-10:00 AM PT
- Thu 11/26 1:00-2:00 PM PT

If none of those work, suggest two windows that do and I'll coordinate. Also:
- Please share any initial success criteria you want included (we have a one-page template in the Drive link below).
- If possible, include the primary technical contact who will join the deep dive (SRE/infra).
- Any immediate blockers (e.g., procurement/legal items) so we can loop in the right folks.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EvalPlanExample

Thanks — I'll follow up with calendar invites once you pick a time.
